title: Implement appbuilder build init
description: Create cli/lib/build.js exporting build(cwd, args). Implement the init subcommand: gate on build/<slug>/scaffold-report.json existing, read the compiled task-plan, and write build/<slug>/build-manifest.json with every task pre-listed as status pending (empty files, empty reason). Refuse to overwrite without --force. Wire the router case "build" to build(cwd, args) and update help text. Test-first.
acceptance_criteria: build init <slug> writes a schema-valid manifest with one pending entry per plan task.
build init fails clearly when scaffold-report.json is absent.
build init refuses to overwrite an existing manifest without --force.
